subtitle: Two shows. One hour. Nobody is well.
tagline: The continental wrestling desk, updated every night at the bell.
oneDivision: One division. Every gender in it. That has never once been the controversial part.

slam.name: Hexa-Slam Continental Wrestling
slam.ethos: Hexes are legal, gravity is a suggestion and the paperwork is written afterwards in whatever is left of the ring.

circle.name: Sanctioned Circle of Grappling Arts
circle.ethos: Eleven permitted holds, three permitted invocations, one notary at ringside and a mat that remembers every foot placed on it.

label.airtime: Both shows go live at {hour}. They always have.
label.tiedNight: The hour was split down the middle
label.noCard: The card has not been posted yet.

condition.cursed: carrying something that is not an injury

school: a Kola wrestling barracks nobody will name
a Ghent dockyard gym with one working light
an unlicensed cellar under the Omega Tower
the Naguka Circle of Standing Stones
a Midwest carnival tent that toured for forty years
their own grandmother, in a kitchen
a correspondence course that should not have worked
gimmick: a retired notary who wrestles to settle contracts
a beekeeper whose swarm is legally part of the entourage
the reanimated gimmick of a wrestler who died in 1974
a monk of a silence order who screams only at the finish
a tax auditor with a grudge against the whole continent
the last graduate of a school that burned down
a weather front that took a human shape and a contract
a hexcaster who insists every spell is a wrestling hold
a butcher who talks to the crowd like they are customers
somebody's actual grandmother, undefeated
a lighthouse keeper who wrestles for the hour of sleep
one of two twins who have never been photographed together
a drag queen who fights in full regalia and has never smudged
a courier who has never once been late to the ring
an exorcist who is losing a long argument with a passenger
a chess prodigy who calls every move before making it
a former traffic warden who tickets illegal moves in the ring
an opera singer whose high note is an actual attack
a cryptid who signed the contract in good faith
a miner who has never seen the top rope from the top

signature: a suplex performed at half speed on purpose
a hex that only makes the opponent honest
a top-rope entry from no visible rope
a chop that frosts the ropes
a hold that borrows the crowd's breath
a lariat announced in advance and unavoidable anyway
a submission that resolves as a legal document
a dive that pauses briefly at the apex
a strike delivered by a shadow half a second early

stipulation: Straight fall, one referee, no invocations
Sealed Circle: nobody in, nothing out, salt on the apron
Mirror Match: the ring is doubled, only one is real
Inverted Gravity Cage
Chain of Notaries: every fall witnessed and stamped
Candle Match: the loser is whoever the last candle stops liking
Ladder to a contract nobody has read
Two falls out of three, the third fought in the dark
Summoner's Gauntlet: each wrestler brings one thing
Lumberjack match, lumberjacks provided by the commission
First Blood, Then Paperwork
Ghost Rules: the referee is deceased and counting slowly
Weather Permitting
Strap Match, strap of unclear provenance
Casket Match, casket rented

finish.knockout: {loser} did not answer the count after {move}.
finish.banishment: {move} put {loser} somewhere the referee could not count them out of.
finish.countout: {loser} was counted out and has still not come back.
finish.interference: {winner} won after {third} came through the crowd and did {reason}.
finish.double: Both went down to {move}. The commission is reviewing the tape and the tape is reviewing back.
finish.draw: Time limit. {winner} and {loser} shook hands and neither let go first.

dqReason: an unlicensed hex in a licensed building
a chair that was, legally, a person
refusing to stop after the bell for nine minutes
bringing a notary into the ring without filing
an invocation in a language the commission cannot transcribe
interferenceDeed: a very calm handshake that took ten years off the referee
nothing at all, which was worse
the thing they promised to do on Tuesday

rivalry.name: {a} and {b} cannot be in the same building
beat: {a} called {b} out by their legal name, which is not done.
{b} attacked {a} during someone else's entrance.
The commission put a partition between their dressing rooms. {a} wrestled through it.
{a} and {b} were booked as partners. It lasted four minutes.
{b} has started arriving at the building before it opens, to wait.

betrayal.name: {b} owes {a} an explanation
beat: {b} walked away from the ring while {a} was still in the hold.
{a} found a clause in their own contract, signed by {b}.
{b} says it was for {a}'s own good and will not elaborate.
{a} has stopped naming {b} in promos. That is the worst sign.

titlechase.name: {a} is coming for the {title}
beat: {a} has pinned three contenders in eleven nights and asked for nothing else.
The commission cannot find a reason to deny {a} a shot, and has looked hard.
{b} says {a} is not ready. {a} agrees, and wants the match anyway.
{a} carried a second belt to the ring and left it in the centre.

curse.name: Something is wrong with {a}
beat: {a}'s entrance music played twice, and only one of them was in the building.
{a} won, then asked the referee who had won.
Two rows behind {a}'s corner are being kept empty on medical advice.
{a} has begun speaking in the past tense about tomorrow's match.

possession.name: {a} is not alone in there
beat: The passenger took over at the count of two and let {a} back at three.
{a} filed a complaint against themselves. It was accepted.
The Hexorcist Corps has sent an observer, who has stopped taking notes.
{b} has offered to help. {a}'s passenger accepted before {a} could.

contract.name: Nobody has read {a}'s contract
beat: {a}'s contract obliges the promotion to a match nobody remembers agreeing to.
A clause was found requiring {b} to defend the {title} on demand.
The document is now thirty pages long and grows on nights {a} loses.
{a} offered to tear it up in the ring. The commission said no, quickly.

factionwar.name: {a}'s people and {b}'s people, again
beat: Both stables cleared the ring and then the concourse.
{b} recruited somebody from {a}'s corner during the broadcast.
A truce was signed at ringside and held for one commercial break.
The commission has banned everyone from ringside and everyone came anyway.

ghost.name: The old champion is back for {a}
beat: A retired name nobody has said aloud in years appeared on {a}'s entrance video.
{a} has been wrestling toward a corner that is not occupied.
The old belt was found in {a}'s bag. {a} did not put it there.
{a} has started using a finish that belongs to somebody long dead.

respect.name: {a} and {b} keep trying to finish this cleanly
beat: Forty minutes, one fall, both still standing at the end of it.
{b} refused a count when {a}'s shoulder was up, and cost themselves the match.
They have agreed on a third match and on nothing else in their lives.
{a} asked the crowd to stop booing {b}. It did not take.

invasion.name: {a} wants to wrestle for the other lot
beat: {a} was seen in the other promotion's building, not wrestling, just looking.
A contract offer from across the hour was read out on air.
{b} says a defector is worse than a heel and would know.
{a} has started wearing the wrong colours to the wrong show.

face: I have heard the count three times tonight and got up on two every time.
You came out in the rain for this, so I will not waste it.
I do not have a speech. I have a match and I have you.
heel: Sit down. All of you. The professionals are working.
I do not need this crowd. I have never needed this crowd.
You cheer for the ones who lose beautifully. I win ugly and I sleep well.
enigma: I was told to say something. This is something.
There is a version of tonight where I do not come out here at all. I looked at it.
Count with me. Not to three. Keep going.

callout: {foe}. You knew where I was. You have always known where I was.
They gave you the {title} and you have been apologising for it ever since, {foe}.
{foe}, I watched your last match twice, and the second time I watched the crowd.
I have a name for what you did, {foe}, and the commission has a form for it.
{foe}, you wrestle like somebody reading their own contract in the dark.
answer: You want a speech about respect. I want the {title}.
I did what I did. I would file it again.
You say my name like it belongs to you. It does not. Nothing does.
I am not here to be understood, {foe}. I am here at {hour}.
One of us leaves that ring standing, and it has never once been you.
boast: {move} has ended eleven careers and started two.
I have never lost in this building and this building has never forgiven me for it.
I trained at {school}. You trained on television.
There is no hex in the book that survives contact with my hands.
threat: Tomorrow, under that stipulation, I am going to be extremely thorough.
Bring whoever you like. I will count them on the way in.
I am going to take the {title} off you slowly, so the tape is useful later.
When the bell goes I stop being polite, and I am being polite now.

face: Same hour. Same ring. Bring the noise.
I will be the one still standing. Look for me.
heel: Do not applaud. You will only encourage yourselves.
I have said what I came to say. Cut my music.
Enjoy the rest of the card. It is all you are getting.
enigma: That is all I was given to say.
I will see some of you tomorrow.
The hour is coming whether we talk or not.

third: I have been standing here the whole time. Neither of you looked.
Whatever you two settle tomorrow, I am the one who collects.
I signed for this match before either of you were told about it.
fourth: This was a two-person conversation an hour ago.
I came out to stop this and I have changed my mind.
Put my name on the contract or get out of my building.

slam: That is not a legal hold in eleven countries and we are in one of them!
The ring is on fire. The referee is counting. This is wrestling.
Get the notary! GET THE NOTARY!
They have been banished and they are still arguing!
The crowd is chanting the finish before it happens. They are usually right.
circle: Third permitted invocation of the night, correctly declared.
That is a point of technique you will see argued about for years.
The notary has stamped the fall. It stands.
Forty seconds of nothing and it is the best forty seconds on the continent.

headline.tie: Dead heat at {viewers} apiece. Nobody is admitting it.

hexapedia.categoryIntro: Every contracted wrestler of the two continental promotions, as filed. Both promotions run one open division and have never run any other kind.
bio: {w} wrestles for {fed}, out of {place}, and is {gimmick}.
Trained at {school}, {w} works a {style} game and finishes with {move}.
{w} came up out of {place} and has never given a straight answer about why.
Filed under the open division, like everyone else on the continent: {fed} has never run any other kind.
hexapedia.careerLine: {wins} wins, {losses} losses across {total} nights on television.
hexapedia.noAngles: Nothing on file. This is unusual and the desk is watching.

mundane.note: {w} has no arcana at all and has never pretended otherwise.
mundane.wikiLine: Registered mundane: no invocation, no hex, no licence. {w} wrestles with hands and weight and nothing else.
promo: I do not have a hex. I have never had a hex. I have hands.
You brought a ritual to a wrestling match. I brought forty minutes of cardio.
Half this roster needs a licence to touch me. I need a taped wrist.
When your candle goes out you will still be in the hold.
They call me mundane like it is a weight class. Fine. I am the champion of it.
commentary: No arcana on that side of the ring and none needed!
A mundane wrestler outworking a ritualist, and the building knows it.
That hex did everything it was supposed to do and the mundane got up anyway.

deadWorld: Nobody is promoting anything. There is no card, no hour to win and nothing to bet on: both channels have been dead air for as long as anyone here can remember.

world.severed: Magic is severed in this world. Every wrestler on both rosters is mundane, every match is a straight fall, and the commission has never had to ban a single hex.
world.unbound: Magic is unbound in this world. Almost nobody on either roster is mundane and almost nothing on either card is legal anywhere else.
world.monster: Both promotions card creatures and animals. There has never been a human wrestler in either building and the crowd would not know what to do with one.
world.zombie: Both rosters are dead and both shows still go out at the same hour. The count is slower. Everything else is the same.
world.goblin: Both promotions are Varlenian concerns, and the Circle has the older rulebook by about nine hundred years.
